title: Nick Monzi:
headline: People hear math and basketball and think fun. The CEO has spent a decade proving it is also rigorous.
story: Nick Monzi is Learn Fresh's CEO and co-founder. The assumption he fights: people think the program is fun, but don't connect it to rigorous outcomes.

A math teacher built the game to meet kids where their interests are. It builds math fluency and connection: sportsmanship, resilience, integrity. The payoff: fun, joyful, but also effective and rigorous for kids.

Loops: L1 “Fun, but does it work?” opens at 0:00 and closes at the button. L2 “Where did it come from?” opens at 0:10 and closes at 0:20. Stakes: a program people take less seriously because it is fun.
do: Open on “When people hear that the program is focused on math and basketball” with the hook text already on screen.
Only use footage after 00:53. His first take has no mic and the wrong org name.
Super: Nick Monzi / CEO & Co-Founder, Learn Fresh. Captions spell Monzi and Tim Scheidt.
Cut to kids playing on “connection with their peers”.
End on “effective and rigorous for kids”, then the Learn more end card.

No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
